<!--
Release note: one plain-language line for players, shown in the release notes
(.github/scripts/release_notes.py). Say what changes for someone using DoD
Studio, not how the code changed. Optional prefix: "New:", "Fixed:" or
"Changed:" (default Changed:, or Fixed: with the bug label, New: with the
enhancement label). Write "none" for internal work (CI, tests, refactors, docs).
Examples:
  Release note: Fixed: The game no longer crashes on the first frame of a preview.
  Release note: New: Split a demo into rounds from the queue.
  Release note: none
-->
Release note: <one plain-language line for players, or "none">
